purpose: Prepare real original-platform LOPO without relabeling five new software stacks or recovering missing historical observations by estimation

scope_modes.historical_canonical5000: Original frozen record IDs and original graph/checkpoint/feature/target transforms required; full 31220 opportunity status ledger and original run binding.
scope_modes.prospective_original_five_platforms: New revalidation on the original five named device families; report new campaign and exact variant; never certify historical canonical5000 or historical14.3.

status_rules.measured: Physical repeats with exact raw file hash+JSON pointer; provenance parents empty.
status_rules.calibrated: Explicit parents and calibration method evidence; excluded from strict LOPO train/validation/test.
status_rules.estimated: Explicit parents and formula evidence; excluded from strict LOPO train/validation/test.
status_rules.missing: No latency; truthful unavailable-source reason, not failure or unsupported.

evidence_reference.path: Path relative to this package root (or an explicitly provided absolute path during private validation) to an immutable JSON file.
evidence_reference.pointer: RFC6901 pointer identifying the exact row/object

planned_sampling_protocol.note: Prospective collection plan; data contract accepts archived raw repeats >=5 and reports actual protocol. All devices must synchronize device work before timing readout.

split_rule.train: source_model train27 AND platform != heldout; measured only
split_rule.validation: source_model validation3 AND platform != heldout; measured only
split_rule.test: source_model test4 AND platform == heldout; measured only
split_rule.preprocessing: fit transformations and feature selection on train labels only; target-platform descriptor specs permitted; all target-platform latency labels excluded.
split_rule.graph: remove all heldout performance labels/edges; training similarity edges must have both endpoints in train source models.
split_rule.checkpoint: select on validation only; freeze each checkpoint before opening target-platform test labels; log split/checkpoint/feature hashes.
metrics: MRE micro with exact sample denominator
macro by source model and operator family
per-platform and pooled results, no mixing denominators

execution_order: Recover or collect exact configuration and hardware identity.
Create complete opportunity status ledger with no invented outcomes.
Run validator --stage labels; any failure blocks fold construction.
Run validator --build-folds; plan contains strict immutable record memberships.
Train each pre-registered method/seed using frozen folds; persist checkpoints, per-query target/prediction pairs, transforms and train IDs.
Independent audit checks raw source hashes, leakage, coverage and all per-seed metrics.
not_ready_until: All five named physical devices or valid historic records are available.
Complete original instance/source-model binding, raw repeats, variant/runtime metadata and provenance recovered.
Original checkpoint study additionally needs saved64-dimensional transform, target units/transform and original graph binding.
Concrete source operator-instance to executable graph-node/configuration mapping and benchmark-family grouping must be frozen; original catalog includes symbolic shapes and primitive operators.
current_priority: Recover verifiable per-query historical timings before constructing strict LOPO folds; do not substitute derived estimates or other device partitions.
